welcome.title: Welcome to Pocket Alert
welcome.text:
Alerts from your servers, scripts and webhooks land here.
The notifier keeps checking in the background and beeps when something new arrives, even with the app closed.

keys.title: Getting around
keys.text:
4-8  buttons in the bottom bar
F X or arrows  move, hold to scroll
Enter  open   Esc  back
hold Esc  quit the app

inbox.title: In the inbox
inbox.text:
R  read / unread   D  delete
U  unread only   S  search
N  new message   G  refresh
8  menu with everything else

help.title: Help is one key away
help.text:
fn+H  keys for the screen you are on
Menu → Help  all shortcuts and this tour
Settings  sound, language, theme

launch: Show this tour at every launch
